projects.title: Goyaz Jewellery — Premium Story-Led Silver Jewellery Commerce

overview.paragraph: Designed and prototyped an evidence-based conversion strategy for a premium silver jewellery retailer, closing the gap between editorial brand storytelling and shoppable commerce transactions.
bullets: Audited Homepage campaigns, collections explorer, filter drawers, search overlays, and PDP interaction points.
Replaced non-functional placeholder CTAs with real, context-aware routed destinations.
Tuned cinematic overlay unmount timing from 1500ms down to a standard 250ms for low-latency feedback.
Designed trust-building PDP specs: clear silver purity, material details, delivery SLAs, and certification proof.
Structured design-system guidelines for focus-visible styles, mobile-first tap targets, and semantic links.
Created a comprehensive research plan focusing on bridal, gifting, and returning customer personas.

steps: IA Audit → Map category structures and identify dead-end paths
User Research → Frame bridal, gifting, and returning segments
Friction Reduction → Standardize overlay unmount delays and CTAs
Trust Layer → Add decision-grade material and certification details to PDP
Token Governance → Align globals.css colors with interactive components
Analytics → Instrument search, filtering, and add-to-cart metrics

impact: Removed 100% of dead-end links and placeholder navigation paths.
Lowered interface latency down to the Doherty Threshold (< 400ms perceived delay).
Established a conversion-ready, robust design system framework.

projects.title: Sturdy Studio — Avant-Garde Dual-Brand Fashion E-Commerce

overview.paragraph: Engineered the UI/UX architecture and brand state mapping for a premium dual-brand fashion platform, enabling low-latency transitions between distinct shopping spaces.
bullets: Designed a smart brand-switching toggle that maps brand states (Fashion vs. Collections) via CSS variables.
Refactored the image preloading and deferred visual assets to prevent above-the-fold media drag.
Replaced raw hardcoded styles with centralized, robust semantic tokens inside design-tokens.css.
Resolved PDP sizing and fit uncertainties by introducing a progressive disclosure information stack.
Integrated Google OAuth layouts and Medusa e-commerce sales channel separation rules.
Built mobile-optimized grid drawers to replace heavy desktop mega-menus on touch interfaces.

steps: Brand Strategy → Establish distinct Fashion vs. Collections missions
Token Setup → Bind Zustand states to responsive HTML attributes
Performance Audit → Standardize LCP and INP budgets for visual pages
Card Design → Expose decision-relevant fit and stock info directly on cards
API Integration → Separate Medusa channel IDs and OAuth configurations
Mobile Tuning → Stack grids and implement touch-friendly filter drawers

tools: Backend integration: Medusa Commerce API Client
impact: Created a seamless, single-click brand-switching system with zero layout reflows.
Optimized Core Web Vitals targets: LCP < 2.5s and INP < 200ms on mobile.
Standardized 100% of e-commerce interaction states: loading, empty, and disabled.

Structured service cards with explicit benefits, expected durations, and next-step actions.

projects.title: Mallikarjuna CMA — Auditing, Advisory & Trust-Led Service Portal

overview.paragraph: Overhauled the performance UX and service discovery taxonomy for a major accounting firm portal, resolving critical layout instability and unused payload assets.
bullets: Audited and resolved high Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS: 0.925 down to < 0.05) across long content layouts.
Restructured the broad service registry containing 38 services into 6 intuitive pathways.
Integrated Framer Motion staggered reveals and Lenis smooth scrolling with performance safety rules.
Redesigned the Meet the Experts trust section to pull dynamic credentials and geographic details.
Established a single source of truth for business contact details and hours across three files.
Engineered mobile-first responsive grids that prevent horizontal container overflows.

steps: Diagnostics → Identify layout shifts and payload waste from Lighthouse logs
Taxonomy → Reorganize 38 services into 6 progressive service pillars
Refactoring → Implement size-reserved image boxes and layout stabilizers
Smooth Scroll → Harmonize Lenis scrolling speeds with dynamic motion
Mobile QA → Resolve responsive container clipping and tap target sizing
State Control → Design explicit skeletons, empty blocks, and active tags

impact: Reduced Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) from an unstable 0.925 down to a stable 0.04.
Optimized loading payloads, cutting initial JavaScript waste by over 1.8 MB.
Created a cohesive, fast service directory for international NRI clients.

projects.title: Show Off Salon — Luxury Grooming & Booking Funnel Optimization

overview.paragraph: Redesigned the digital conversion funnel for a high-end salon, unifying scheduling systems and correcting data mismatches to elevate client trust.
bullets: Unified duplicate scheduling interfaces into a singular, cohesive multi-step booking funnel.
Prefilled specific service selections from catalog cards directly into the booking inputs.
Resolved business data conflicts (address, telephone, open slots) across five files.
Enhanced specialized hair-fixing and bridal visibility by integrating consultation assurance.
Implemented real-time input validation and robust inline error handling to ensure form validity.

Funnel Unification → Build a robust, single-path 4-step wizard
Interaction Design → Animate step transitions and build error callouts
Performance → Group visual assets and lazy-load testimonials
Dashboard Spec → Design secure client history and rebooking widgets

impact: Unified 100% of scheduling endpoints, removing conflicting local booking simulations.
Secured business details consistency across all home, booking, and contact footers.
Enabled low-friction prefill logic matching 38 specific service catalog options.

projects.title: OCR Handwritten Text Extraction — Bank Deposit Forms

overview.paragraph: Designed and implemented a high-accuracy handwritten OCR system for bank deposit forms by integrating computer vision, object detection, and transformer-based OCR models.
bullets: Built an end-to-end OCR pipeline using YOLOv8, OpenCV, Roboflow, and Hugging Face models to extract handwritten and printed fields from structured bank deposit forms.
Used YOLOv8 for precise field-level detection (account number, amount, date, depositor name, PAN, etc.), ensuring region-specific OCR instead of full-image extraction.
Prepared and managed annotated datasets using Roboflow, enabling efficient labeling, augmentation, and version control for OCR training.
Applied OpenCV preprocessing techniques (grayscale conversion, noise removal, thresholding, perspective correction) to improve handwriting clarity and OCR confidence.
Integrated Hugging Face Transformer-based OCR models (handwritten text recognition) to extract text with high accuracy and consistency.
Implemented confidence filtering and validation logic to reject low-confidence predictions and improve overall reliability.
Structured extracted data into JSON / database-ready formats for downstream processing and validation.
Optimized the pipeline for real-world banking scenarios, handling variations in handwriting styles, lighting conditions, and form alignment.

steps: Image Input → Bank deposit form scan/photo
Preprocessing → OpenCV (denoise, threshold, alignment)
Field Detection → YOLOv8 (trained via Roboflow annotations)
Text Recognition → Hugging Face handwritten OCR model
Post-processing → Confidence scoring, validation, formatting
Output → Structured digital data for banking workflows

tools: Output Formats: JSON, CSV, Database-ready schemas
impact: Achieved high-confidence handwritten text extraction suitable for financial documents.
Reduced manual data entry and verification effort.
Built a scalable OCR framework adaptable to other structured forms.

projects.title: Multi-tenant HR Management Application

overview.paragraph: Designed and developed a scalable HRMS with isolated, dynamic URN-based routing to ensure tenant-level data isolation and high performance.
bullets: Built a multi-tenant architecture with tenant isolation and dynamic URN-based routing.
Implemented UUID-based database architecture for secure and unique record identification across tenants.
Developed the frontend with React, Redux, and Tailwind CSS.
Built the backend using Node.js with Prisma ORM, Redis, SQL (phpMyAdmin), and Docker.
Collaborated with Figma for UI/UX and GitHub for version control.

steps: Tenant Routing → URN-based tenant resolution
Data Layer → UUID-based schema with tenant isolation
API + ORM → Node.js + Prisma
Performance → Redis caching
Deployment → Dockerized services

impact: Enabled tenant-level data isolation with scalable routing.
Improved security and uniqueness using UUID-based records.
Optimized performance with Redis and containerized deployment.

projects.title: Insurance Web Application

overview.paragraph: Built a full-featured insurance platform with strong authentication, policy and claims workflows, and a conversational assistant for users.
bullets: Built the platform using Next.js, NextAuth, TypeScript, SQLite3, and Prisma ORM.
Implemented policy management, claims processing, role-based access, and dashboards for agents and customers.
Integrated a multi-functional chatbot assistant for policy queries, claim initiation, document guidance, and FAQs.
Added secure online payment functionality for premium payments and renewals with real-time status tracking and transaction history.
Deployed on AWS EC2 and established CI/CD using GitHub Actions.

steps: Authentication → NextAuth role-based access
Policy Management → Create/renew/manage policies
Claims → Submit and track claim workflows
Assistant → Chatbot for guidance and FAQs
Payments → Premium/renewal checkout with tracking
Delivery → AWS EC2 + GitHub Actions CI/CD

impact: Enabled end-to-end policy and claims workflows for users and agents.
Improved user support via a conversational assistant.
Streamlined releases with CI/CD on AWS.

Supported community interaction via nested comments and moderation.

projects.title: Civil Construction Project Management Application

overview.paragraph: Designed a construction project management tool for teams to plan, manage, and collaborate on projects with drawing workflows and a Three.js pipeline.
bullets: Core features include project timelines, drawing uploads, team chat, and progress tracking.
Developed with React.js, SQL, and Three.js with a focus on scalability and modular design.
Enabled multi-user collaboration with role-based access control using a Django backend.
Used AWS Lambda for background tasks (scheduled reports) and S3 for drawing storage.
Implemented a Three.js pipeline including CAD → PDF conversion (Lambda), WebGL optimization (LOD controls), annotation storage in S3 metadata, and automated redline markups using Fabric.js.

steps: Upload → Store drawings in S3
Convert → CAD → PDF via AWS Lambda
Visualize → Three.js viewer + WebGL optimizations (LOD)
Annotate → Redlines with Fabric.js
Persist → Annotation metadata stored in S3
Collaborate → Role-based access with Django backend

impact: Enabled collaborative construction planning and drawing workflows.
Automated CAD → PDF conversion and optimized 3D rendering performance.
Improved drawing review via persistent annotations and automated redlines.
